first_reader_said: NEH 10:27: A's notes already place Baanah on the sealed document at 10:27, and B is that same sealer with nothing added.

why: B contains only the covenant sealer named in NEH 10:27, whom A already explicitly includes in its notes and verses. A also supplies EZR 2:2 and NEH 7:7 and fuller family associations; B adds no distinct father, generation, or other identifying detail.
